description: Find companies by name (or name fragment) across the pan-European dataset. Returns ranked candidates with registry identifier, country, legal form and status. Use this FIRST when you only know a name; then pass the identifier + country to lookup_company or company_brief. Do not use it to filter by industry or size — that is advanced_search.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the register (e.g. SK, CZ, AT, PL). Strongly recommended: registry numbers are NOT unique across countries (an SK and a CZ company can share the same 8-digit IČO), and without it the server picks one by tie-break.

name: search_companies

data.description: Array of candidate companies, best match first.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id (quote it in support requests), duration_ms, cached.

title: Search companies by name
